item.title: Love Story
item.description: 记录彼此的言语温度，珍藏聊天里的心动瞬间。 🎵 Love Story · 温柔循环 🔊 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { const player = document.querySelector('.love-music-player'); if (!player) return; const audio = new Audio(player.dataset.src || '/audio/lovestory.mp3'); const playBtn = player.querySelector('button'); const volumeSlider = player.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); audio.loop = true; audio.preload = 'metadata'; audio.volume = (volumeSlider?.value || 35) / 100; function
